steps.name: api-member-warnings
command: from pathlib import Path; import sys; p=Path(sys.argv[1]); logs=[p/'packaged-consumer.log',*p.glob('api-*.log')]; bad=[str(f)+': '+line for f in logs for line in f.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines() if "Couldn't resolve a member for the given link query" in line]; print('Unresolved member-link warnings:',len(bad)); print('\n'.join(bad)); sys.exit(bool(bad))
